stashkit.core.name: StashKit
stashkit.core.description:
The primary framework for transforming messy real-world inputs into structured, domain-aware entities using resolvers and skills, backed by one or more StashDexes and persisted in user Stashes.

StashKit core is domain-neutral; domain-specific resolvers are supplied by BoosterPacks.

responsibilities: Coordinate resolvers and skills to interpret heterogeneous inputs.
Build and manage StashDexes as lexical and ontological references.
Normalize messy inputs into structured entities suitable for storage in Stashes.
Manage registration of skills, resolvers, StashDexes, and BoosterPacks.
Provide a stable, high-level API (e.g. fetch) for applications and BoosterPacks.
Support iterative, multi-pass resolution where Resolvers revisit their skill chains as new information is discovered until completion or no further progress is possible.
Remain domain-neutral while allowing BoosterPacks to introduce domain-specific Resolvers and Skills on top of core abstractions.

public_methods.name: fetch
public_methods.description: Invoke a resolver → skill-chain → Dex pipeline to interpret a request. May optionally store the result in a Stash.

public_methods.name: register_skill
public_methods.description: Register a Skill in the system-wide registry.

public_methods.name: register_resolver
public_methods.description: Register a Resolver in the system-wide registry.

public_methods.name: install_booster
public_methods.description: Install a BoosterPack and register its components.

public_methods.name: get_dex
public_methods.description: Retrieve a StashDex by identifier and optional version.

public_methods.name: create_stash
public_methods.description: Create a new Stash with the given identifier and optional metadata.

public_methods.name: use_booster_pack
public_methods.description: Install and activate a BoosterPack by identifier, allowing it to register resolvers, skills, Stashes, and defaults used by easy-path operations.

public_methods.name: resolve
public_methods.description: Resolve an input request (e.g. file path or in-memory descriptor) by selecting an appropriate Resolver, orchestrating its skill chain, and returning a StashCard or partial entity. On success, the resulting StashCard may be automatically stashed into the active default Stash.

public_methods.name: resolve_directory
public_methods.description: Resolve all supported artifacts in a directory using registered Resolvers. Intended for batch operations and BoosterPack-driven workflows, emitting progress and summary information.

internal_methods.name: _dispatch_resolver
internal_methods.description: Internal resolver selection and invocation logic.

properties.name: registry
properties.description: Registry of installed skills, resolvers, StashDexes, and BoosterPacks, including resolver-selection metadata (e.g. selectors for request types, file patterns, or domains).

properties.name: default_stash
properties.description: Reference to the currently active default Stash used by easy-path APIs (e.g. resolve, resolve_directory).

events.name: on_resolver_missing
events.description: Fired when no resolver can interpret a request.

events.name: on_resolution_progress
events.description: Emitted periodically during batch or long-running resolution to report progress for CLI or UI feedback.

events.name: on_resolution_error_report
events.description: Emitted when a Resolver run produces an error-report artifact or structured error payload.

ada.core.name: ADA
ada.core.description:
The AppDex Design Assistant (ADA) is an ML/LLM-backed assistant responsible for
interviewing humans, interpreting scenarios, and proposing updates to AppDex models.
It does not execute application code; it curates and refines architecture models.

responsibilities: Conduct structured interviews and scenario walkthroughs with humans.
Infer domains, components, workflows, and overlays for AppDex models.
Assign and maintain origin/maturity/confidence metadata on AppDex elements.

appdex.architect.name: AppDex Architect
appdex.architect.description:
A schema-driven, language-agnostic modeling tool for describing application structure.
AppDex Architect works primarily through an assistant (ADA) that elicits scenarios,
infers domains/components/flows, and maintains AppDex models as a source of truth
for realization engines such as DexPort and UXDex.

responsibilities: Host the AppDex schema used to describe applications at a logical level.
Manage versioned AppDex models per application or project.
Coordinate with ADA to ingest scenarios and update AppDex models.
Expose AppDex models to downstream tools such as DexPort and UXDex.

public_methods.name: create_model
public_methods.description: Create a new AppDex model for an application with initial metadata.

public_methods.name: get_model
public_methods.description: Retrieve a previously created AppDex model by identifier.

dexport.core.name: DexPort
dexport.core.description:
DexPort is a realization engine that maps AppDex models into concrete implementations
for specific languages and ecosystems. It uses mapping policies, target intents, and
confidence overlays to produce code, configuration, and interface artifacts.

responsibilities: Interpret AppDex models for a chosen target ecosystem (e.g. Python, Go, Rust).
Apply mapping policies and target intents to select implementation patterns.
Generate code, configuration, and interface definitions as artifacts.

public_methods.name: plan_realization
public_methods.description: Produce a high-level realization plan for an AppDex model and target intent.

stashkit.resolvers.name: Resolver Subsystem
stashkit.resolvers.description:
Resolves user requests by orchestrating skills, consulting StashDexes, and assembling coherent entities suitable for persistence in Stashes.

BaseResolver defines the abstract resolution lifecycle. ItemResolver is the primary concrete implementation that drives iterative, multi-pass resolution against a configured skill chain for a given StashDex.

Resolver hierarchy:
  - BaseResolver: abstract base class defining the general resolution lifecycle.
  - ItemResolver: minimal concrete Resolver with no default Skills, suitable for arbitrary items.
  - ProductResolver: domain-general Resolver for tangible commercial products; typically used as a base for product-oriented BoosterPacks.

responsibilities: Gather raw or partial inputs from multiple signal sources.
Invoke appropriate skills in a configured or dynamic sequence.
Maintain partial entities and confidence models while merging proposals.
Consult StashDexes for normalization, classification, and enrichment.
Decide when resolution is sufficient using domain-specific termination rules.
Produce structured domain entities ready to be stored in Stashes.
Coordinate iterative passes over a skill chain, re-running applicable skills as new information becomes available on the partial entity.
Use skill applicability checks (e.g. can_run/context requirements) to decide which skills to invoke at each pass.
Determine completion based on termination rules and minimum viable fields on the partial entity, not just one-shot execution.
BaseResolver defines the abstract resolution lifecycle and contracts for all Resolvers.
ItemResolver is the simplest concrete Resolver and ships with no default Skills, relying entirely on configured or BoosterPack-supplied skills.
ProductResolver subclasses ItemResolver and introduces a default skill-chain suitable for tangible commercial products.

public_methods.name: resolve
public_methods.description: Interpret a request by gathering signals, applying skills, consulting StashDexes, and building a structured entity.

internal_methods.name: _apply_skills
internal_methods.description: Construct the skill chain and apply it, updating the partial entity and confidence model.

internal_methods.name: _score_candidates
internal_methods.description: Score and rank candidate entities based on confidence and domain rules.

properties.name: domain
properties.description: The domain or entity type handled by this resolver (e.g. product, bottle, herb, item).

properties.name: target_entity_type
properties.description: The concrete entity class or schema the resolver attempts to produce.

properties.name: required_fields
properties.description: Field names that must be populated before the resolver considers an entity complete.

properties.name: optional_fields
properties.description: Field names that may be populated when available but are not required for completion.

properties.name: skill_sequence
properties.description: Ordered or conditional sequence of skills that this resolver may invoke.

properties.name: termination_rules
properties.description: Rules that describe when resolution should stop.

properties.name: conflict_resolution_strategy
properties.description: Strategy for reconciling conflicting proposals from skills or Dex lookups.

properties.name: supported_dexes
properties.description: Identifiers of StashDexes this resolver knows how to consult.

events.name: on_ambiguous_match
events.description: Fired when multiple entities or interpretations match with similar confidence.

events.name: on_resolution_complete
events.description: Fired when the resolver produces a complete entity.

events.name: on_partial_resolution
events.description: Fired when resolution stops with a partial entity.

stashkit.skills.name: Skill Subsystem
stashkit.skills.description:
Skills are composable units that operate on specific signal types (text, barcode, image, user input, partial entities, etc.) and propose field-level changes, often with confidence and provenance information, for resolvers to merge.

Skills in core StashKit are domain-neutral; BoosterPacks provide domain-specific Skills.

responsibilities: Extract information from input signals such as text, barcodes, or images.
Transform or normalize values (e.g. canonicalizing product names or brands).
Query external APIs or databases for enrichment.
Interact with users to request missing or clarifying information.
Propose updates to one or more fields on a partial entity.
Expose clear applicability criteria so resolvers can efficiently decide which skills to invoke on each resolution pass.

public_methods.name: can_run
public_methods.description: Return True if the skill is applicable to the current context (e.g. based on signal type, available fields, or Dex references).

public_methods.name: apply
public_methods.description: Apply the skill to the given input (and optional context), returning proposed field updates with optional confidence and provenance.

internal_methods.name: _validate
internal_methods.description: Internal check for input structure and type prior to application.

properties.name: skill_id
properties.description: Unique identifier used for registration and selection by resolvers.

properties.name: signal_type
properties.description: Signal type accepted by this skill (e.g. text, barcode, image, user_input, partial_entity).

properties.name: produces_fields
properties.description: Field names that this skill may propose or update on the partial entity.

properties.name: domain_specific
properties.description: Whether the skill is tightly bound to a particular domain or generally reusable.

properties.name: requires_context
properties.description: Whether the skill requires contextual information (e.g. Dex handle, configuration, or stash).

stashkit.stash.name: Stash
stashkit.stash.description: Persistent user collection of resolved entities. Each entity references a StashDex via a short key in the stash-level dex_table. The Dex itself may evolve over time without silently mutating stored entities.

responsibilities: Persist resolved entities so they can be retrieved without re-running full resolution.
Maintain a dex_table mapping short keys (e.g. D1) to fully-qualified Dex identifiers.
Allow entities from multiple domains and Dexes to coexist in one collection.
Support optional re-resolution or re-enrichment when Dexes or resolvers change.

public_methods.name: add
public_methods.description: Add a resolved entity to the stash, associated with a Dex reference key.

public_methods.name: get
public_methods.description: Retrieve a stored entity by identifier.

public_methods.name: list
public_methods.description: List entities matching basic criteria such as domain, tags, or Dex reference key.

public_methods.name: update
public_methods.description: Update fields on a stored entity, preserving historical metadata as needed.

public_methods.name: re_resolve
public_methods.description: Optionally re-run a resolver for a stored entity using current Dex and skill configuration, producing an updated entity while preserving or recording the original snapshot as desired.

internal_methods.name: _ensure_dex_ref
internal_methods.description: Ensure that a Dex identifier/version is present in dex_table and return its key.

properties.name: stash_id
properties.description: Identifier for this stash instance.

properties.name: metadata
properties.description: Optional metadata about the stash (e.g. owner, creation time, app context).

properties.name: dex_table
properties.description: Mapping of short Dex keys (e.g. D1) to fully-qualified Dex identifiers.

properties.name: entities
properties.description: Collection of stored entities in this stash.

uxdex.core.name: UXDex
uxdex.core.description:
UXDex is a declarative model for user-facing structure and interaction patterns.
It aligns UX flows, screens, and widgets with AppDex components and workflows, so
that realization engines can generate coherent UI implementations.

responsibilities: Describe user-facing flows and screens in a structured, implementation-agnostic way.
Align UX elements with AppDex components and workflows.
Provide constraints and hints for UI generation in target ecosystems.

stashkit.boosterpacks.name: BoosterPacks
stashkit.boosterpacks.description:
Optional extension bundles that add domain-specific StashDexes, entity schemas, resolvers, skills, and helper utilities. BoosterPacks allow StashKit to be extended to new domains without modifying the core framework.

BoosterPacks are the primary place to define domain-specific Resolvers (e.g., BottleResolver in BoozeDex) by subclassing core Resolvers such as ItemResolver or ProductResolver. StashKit core itself does not define domain-specific Resolvers.

responsibilities: Package domain-specific Dexes, entities, resolvers, skills, and utilities.
Provide installable extensions that register themselves with StashKit Core.
Support sharing and reuse of domain knowledge and resolution logic.

public_methods.name: install
public_methods.description: Install a BoosterPack by identifier and register its components.

public_methods.name: list
public_methods.description: List installed BoosterPacks and their key components.

public_methods.name: get
public_methods.description: Retrieve metadata about a specific BoosterPack.

properties.name: packs
properties.description: Installed BoosterPacks and their metadata.

stashkit.stashcard.name: StashCard
stashkit.stashcard.description:
A single logical item stored in a Stash. A StashCard represents one resolved thing
(e.g. a bottle, a book, a tool) along with its associated metadata, links to one or
more Dex entries, and any derived traits or overlays.

responsibilities: Represent a single stored item in a Stash, with a stable identifier.
Carry key metadata fields needed by the host application.
Maintain links to one or more StashDex entities for canonical definitions.
Support partial/incremental enrichment over time.

stashkit.stashdex.name: StashDex
stashkit.stashdex.description: A lexicon, ontology, and inference engine for a domain. StashDex provides canonical entities, alias resolution, classification axes, and trait inference. It is not the end-user storage layer; that role is handled by Stash.

responsibilities: Store canonical, domain-specific entities and traits.
Handle aliases and synonyms for user-facing labels.
Provide multi-axis classification (e.g. legal, functional, production-based).
Infer additional traits from partial information and known rules.
Evolve schema and knowledge without breaking previously stored stash entities.

public_methods.name: get
public_methods.description: Retrieve a canonical entity from the Dex by identifier.

public_methods.name: query
public_methods.description: Search the Dex using semantic criteria such as traits, categories, or aliases.

public_methods.name: update
public_methods.description: Insert or update a canonical entity in the Dex.

public_methods.name: resolve_alias
public_methods.description: Resolve a name or alias into a canonical entity or label.

public_methods.name: infer
public_methods.description: Infer additional traits or classifications for a partial entity.

properties.name: version
properties.description: Schema/version identifier for the Dex (e.g. BoozeDex.2025.04).

properties.name: traits
properties.description: Domain traits and classification rules represented by this Dex.

properties.name: alias_maps
properties.description: Mappings from aliases and synonyms to canonical entities or labels.

properties.name: classification_axes
properties.description: Classification dimensions such as bartender_style, legal_category, production_method, use_case.

events.name: on_trait_propagation
events.description: Fired when traits propagate through hierarchies or classification axes.

rules.description: Propagate selected traits from core systems to subsystems.
Ensure that stash entities using a resolver reference Dexes supported by that resolver.

logic.require: stash.entities[*].dex_ref_key resolves via stash.dex_table to a Dex whose id is in resolver.supported_dexes

rules.description: Ensure that stash entities refer to Dexes through the stash dex_table using short keys.
Any BoosterPack that declares a default stash or default resolver must reference valid Stash and Resolver identifiers.

logic.condition: boosterpack.default_stash is not None or boosterpack.default_resolver is not None
logic.require: boosterpack.default_stash in stashkit.stash.ids and boosterpack.default_resolver in stashkit.resolvers.ids
